CVE only affects deprecated libresolv diagnostic helpers ns_printrrf, ns_printrr, and fp_nquery (deprecated since glibc 2.34). GNU libc GLIBC-SA-2026-0012 states they are for application debugging only and not on the code path executed by the DNS resolver when performing normal lookups. Exposure requires linking code that explicitly calls those helpers when printing crafted DNS RR data while standard workloads use resolver APIs such as getaddrinfo/gethostbyname and do not reach this code.

CVE only affects deprecated libresolv diagnostic helpers ns_printrrf, ns_printrr, and fp_nquery (deprecated since glibc 2.34). GNU libc GLIBC-SA-2026-0011 states they are debugging-only helpers and not on the code path exercised by normal DNS resolver operation. Exposure requires linking code that explicitly calls those entry points while handling arbitrary DNS payloads; resolver usage through standard POSIX/NSS resolver interfaces does not reach this code.

GHSA-f9g8-6ppc-pqq4 covers the same apiCall ServiceAccount token injection as GHSA-8wfp-579w-6r25 at pkg/engine/apicall/executor.go. The kyverno admission controller exercises this executor during policy evaluation. Upstream fix is in Kyverno 1.16.4; the packaged 1.15.3 and 1.16.3 lines are below that and no 1.15.x backport has been published. Tracking upstream.

The kyverno admission controller loads ConfigMap context via pkg/engine/context/loaders/configmap.go, whose NewConfigMapLoader does not validate the target namespace (CVE-2026-41068). Upstream fix is in Kyverno 1.17.2; the packaged 1.15.3, 1.16.3, and 1.17.1 lines are below that and no 1.15.x or 1.16.x backport has been published. Tracking upstream.

False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Debian zlib packages (zlib1g and zlib1g-dev) do not ship the untgz utility by default. For Debian Trixie (and other versions), zlib comes from zlib1g (binaries) and does not include the untgz binary. The vulnerability scanner incorrectly flags zlib packages as vulnerable when the untgz utility is not actually present in the installed packages.
